change_from_parent_draft: Replace ambiguous visible backslash-n and illustrative field order/JWK string with the exact choices below. Parent draft has never been normative or implemented; no V1 migration/interpretation change.

domain.signing_input: ASCII(domain) || byte0x0a || exact canonical body UTF8

body.rule: Exactly these18 keys; recursively lexicographic ASCII object-key order including nested JWK, compact UTF8 JSON without whitespace/newline/BOM; strict duplicate-key parser before canonical byte equality. This is not JSON.stringify insertion order or a JWS/JWT envelope.
body.new_JWK_field: public_key_jwk is a nested object; parent illustrative public_key_jwk_canonical string is NOT this candidate field
body.operation_ids: Original canonical lowercase UUIDv4 registration_operation_id and challenge_id; no UUIDv7-family fallback
body.hashes: Exactly declared *_sha256 fields use64 lowercase hex characters; hash equality is data binding only.
body.integers: principal_epoch1..9007199254740990; expected_registry_revision0..9007199254740990; original_authorization_deadline_unix_ms1..9007199254740991; canonical decimal integers only, no -0/exponent/fraction/infinity

JWK.coordinates: x/y canonical unpadded base64url, exactly43chars decoding32bytes each; roundtrip and actual P-256 point import required
JWK.extra_members: Reject private d, alg,kid,use,key_ops and every other extra member
JWK.pin_bytes: UTF8(compact lexicographic JSON of exact four-member JWK), no domain/LF/string wrapper
JWK.pin: lowercase hex SHA256(pin_bytes), equals independently snapshotted expected transcript value. No RFC7638/Source153 authority or cross-family admission inferred.

signature.algorithm: ECDSA P-256 SHA-256 over signing_input bytes; no caller prehash/double-hash
signature.wire: Exactly64 bytes r||s, unsigned big-endian32 each with leading zeros retained; canonical unpadded base64url86chars with exact decode/roundtrip
signature.scalar_rule: 1 <= r < q and 1 <= s < q before cryptographic verification
signature.high_low_S_policy: Accept either in-range s representative if ECDSA verify succeeds; do not require low-S or normalize signature as operation identity. High/low aliases represent the SAME original operation/nonce/body and cannot mint state or renew a deadline. No private signing or normalization performed here.
signature.DER: Never parse DER or convert formats as verification fallback. Wrong-length encodings reject. A64-byte input is interpreted only as r||s, never guessed by first byte.
signature.crypto_exception: Operational crypto failure, not invalid-proof fallback or successful admission

original_expected_comparison.required: Original expected canonical transcript is required as separately supplied pre-await DATA snapshot from owning original preparation; never reconstruct expected from the presented proof
procedure: Copy inputs into privately owned immutable snapshots before async parsing/import/digest/verify
Strict-parse and validate expected body and proof body with the exact schema/canonical byte policy
Require full byte equality of proof body to original expected body before crypto; hash-only matching does not replace this
Recompute and compare exact nested JWK pin; import only that expected original public point for verify
Verify exact fixed-domain signing input and signature scalar/wire policy
Keep original operation/challenge/nonce/body identity in DATA output; no read/crypto result consumes once state, creates principal, validates deadline or establishes operator/install authority
original_expected_comparison.expected_input_is_not_authority: Supplying a matching expected object or public key does not independently qualify that context; actual operator/custody/install/clock/restore/withdrawal admissions remain separate

conformance_scope.encoding_fixture: Expired, explicitly synthetic labels; not an actual Core/principal/authorization or PoP receipt
conformance_scope.scalar_cases: Ten fixed64-byte syntax/range cases; in-range is not signature-valid
conformance_scope.runtime_reference_check: Separate RFC public-vector verification may validate runtime r||s/highS/lowS behavior. That is not a valid signature over this candidate body or actual workerd/registration qualification.
